'''Crossover''' is the 25th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on September 25, 2015. The set consists of 80 cards. This set is part of the ''Mirror Universe Block'' consisting of cards from [[Crossover (expansion)|Crossover]], [[Crossover: Supplemental]], [[Through the Looking Glass]], and [[The Terran Empire]].

==Type Breakdown==
*16 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*6 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Cardassian)
*8 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*11 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*8 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*24 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (5 Bajoran, 2 Cardassian, 7 Federation, 2 Ferengi, 3 Klingon and 7 Non-Aligned)
*4 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian, 2 Federation, 1 Klingon and 2 Non-Aligned)
*1 [[:Category:Site (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Site]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
